item.title: ALC Indore Report, August - October 2019
item.description:
ALC Indore organized the following events during August to October period.

Total event organized - 2

Approximate audience reach - ~200

Events organized in August to October period ¶

Event Date Summary Detail Link
1. Apache Hackathon 24 August 2019 ALC Indore invited local Apache enthusiast and open-source lover to participate in the Apache Hackathon.
The participant will contribute to the Apache projects.
The contribution will include, the code development, project documentation, testing and review patches, etc.
The participants who are new to Apache (or open-source) and it's projects, the ALC Indore will guide them on the ASF, The Apache Way, various Apache Projects, and help them to start their contribution.		 Apache Hackathon - 24 August 2019
2. The Apache Day 28 September 2019

ALC Indore is organizing 'The Apache Day' event for student community at Prestige Institute of Engineering Management & Research institute. The event is planned into two parts.

item.title: ALC Indore Report, November 2019 - January 2020
item.description:
During November to January period, the ALC Indore team was majorly involved in discussions and planning regarding the proposal for the establishment and functioning of the new ALCs with the ComDev community and Apache Board.

The ALC Indore organized the following events during the November to January period.

Total event organized - 1

Approximate audience reach - ~50

Events organized in November to January period ¶

Event Date Summary Detail Link
1. Session on ‘Open Source and ASF Awareness’ for school students 23 November 2019 ALC Indore organized the ‘Open Source and ASF Awareness’ event for the student community at Daisy Dales School on 23 November 2019 in Indore, India. Open Source and ASF Awareness - 23 November 2019

Upcoming events planned are as follows for February to April period. ¶

Event Date Summary Detail Link
1. Apache MiniConf March 2020
(We are working on dates)		 ALC Indore will be organizing a one-day event, mini roadshow type, where we will be inviting speakers from Apache OFBiz, Roller, Spark projects from Indore.
